<view class="screen management-page target-owner-delete">

      </view>
      <view class="meta">
        仅处理你创建的评分对象
      </view>
    </view>
  </view>
  <template is="rating-status" data="{{status,error,receiptStatus,hasSession,frozen,recoveryOperation,busy,needsRefresh}}" />
  <view class="notice">
    此页面核验你是否可以删除此对象，不展示对象详情。即使对象已隐藏，也可通过原链接申请删除。
  </view>
  <view wx:if="{{ready}}" class="card">
    <view class="section-title">
      {{deleted ? '此对象已删除' : '此对象'}}
    </view>
    <button wx:if="{{!deleted}}" bindtap="onDelete" disabled="{{busy || frozen}}" class="management-action">
      删除此对象
    </button>
    <view wx:if="{{deleteConfirmation}}">
      <view class="notice">
        删除后不再公开显示，评分和互动历史会保留。删除后无法恢复，确认删除此对象？
      </view>
      <button bindtap="onConfirmDelete" disabled="{{busy || frozen}}" class="management-destructive">
        确认删除
      </button>
      <button bindtap="onDismissDelete" class="management-quiet">
        暂不删除
      </button>
    </view>
  </view>
  <view wx:if="{{canCancelDeletion}}" class="card">
    <button bindtap="onCancelDeletion" disabled="{{busy}}" class="management-action">
      撤销这次未确认的删除申请
    </button>
    <view wx:if="{{cancelDeletionConfirmation}}">
      <view class="notice">
        确认撤销原删除申请？服务器将关闭尚未完成的原请求；若删除已经成功，只会返回成功回执，不会恢复对象。
      </view>
      <button bindtap="onConfirmCancelDeletion" disabled="{{busy}}" class="management-destructive">
        确认撤销原申请
      </button>
      <button bindtap="onDismissCancelDeletion" disabled="{{busy}}" class="management-action">
        保留原申请
      </button>
    </view>
  </view>
  <button bindtap="onCancel" class="management-quiet">
    关闭确认并停止等待
  </button>
  <button bindtap="onReturnCatalog" class="management-quiet">
    返回目录并重新加载 →
  </button>
</view>
